(CASE WHEN SR.CONFIM = 'D' THEN 'V' ELSE ' ' END) AS INDDEL, NVL((SELECT INDDCL FROM SHPDH WHERE SHPOKY = (SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPRQK = SR.SHPRQK)),' ') AS INDTRN, (CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT MAX(MENGE_R) FROM IFWMS103 WHERE WERKS = SR.OWNRKY AND USRID2 IN (SELECT SVBELN FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = (SELECT MAX(TRNSHP) FROM SHPRQ WHERE SHPRQK = SR.SHPRQK)) AND STATUS IN ('A','C') AND IFFLG IN ('N','Y')),0) > 0 THEN 'V' ELSE ' ' END) AS INDRCV, NVL((SELECT INDDCL FROM SHPDH WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY),' ') AS INDSHP,
SR.CREDAT, SR.CREUSR, AR.RDDALL, NVL((SELECT NAME01 FROM OWNER WHERE OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY),' ') AS OWNRNM, SR.WORKID, SR.STDLNR, SR.C00101 FROM SHPRQ SR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = SR.SKUKEY INNER JOIN BZPTN VD ON VD.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND VD.PTNRKY = SR.DPTNKY AND VD.PTNRTY = 'CT' INNER JOIN AREMA AR ON AR.WAREKY = SR.WAREKY AND AR.AREAKY = SR.AREAKY WHERE 1 = 1
AND SR.WAREKY = #WAREKY#
AND SR.OWNRKY = #OWNRKY#
AND SR.AREAKY = #AREAKY#
AND SR.RQSHPD = #RQSHPD#
AND SR.SHPOKY = #SHPOKY#
AND SR.SKUKEY LIKE '%$SKUKEY$%'
AND UPPER(SM.DESC01) LIKE '%$DESC01$%'
AND SR.CREUSR = #CREUSR#
GROUP BY SR.SHPRQK, SR.LOTA01, SR.WAREKY,SR.OWNRKY, SR.AREAKY, SR.SHPOKY, SR.RQSHPD, SR.CREDAT, SR.CREUSR, AR.RDDALL, SR.CONFIM, SR.WORKID, SR.STDLNR, SR.C00101 ORDER BY SR.SHPRQK

SELECT SR.SHPRQK AS SHPRQK, SR.SHPRQI AS SHPRQI, SR.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY, SM.DESC01 AS DESC01, SM.DESC02 AS DESC02, SM.SKUG05 AS SKUG05, SR.QTYORD AS QTYORD, SR.UOMKEY AS UOMKEY, CASE WHEN TRIM(SR.TRNSHP) IS NOT NULL THEN NVL((SELECT QTSHPO FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI),0) ELSE 0 END AS QTYTRN, CASE WHEN TRIM(SR.TRNSHP) IS NOT NULL THEN NVL((SELECT QTSHPO FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI),0) ELSE 0 END AS QTYTRS, NVL((SELECT MENGE_R FROM IFWMS103 WHERE WERKS = SR.OWNRKY AND (USRID2,DEPTID2) IN (SELECT SVBELN,SPOSNR FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.TRNSHP AND SHPOIT = SR.TRNSHI) AND STATUS IN ('A','C') AND IFFLG IN ('N','Y')),0) AS QTYTRR, NVL((SELECT QTALOC FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTALOC, NVL((SELECT QTJCMP FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTJCMP, NVL((SELECT QTSHPD FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTSHPD, SR.QTYORD - NVL((SELECT QTSHPD FROM SHPDI WHERE SHPOKY = SR.SHPOKY AND SHPOIT = SR.SHPOIT),0) AS QTUSHP, SR.TRNSHP AS TRNSHP, SR.TRNSHI AS TRNSHI, SR.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY, SR.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT, SR.LOTA09 AS MATNR, SR.LOTA10 AS LOTA10, SR.LOTA16 AS LOTA16, SR.LOTA17 AS LOTA17, SR.LOTA02 AS LOTA02, SR.RSNCOD AS RSNCOD, SR.TASRSN AS TASRSN, SR.DOCTXT AS DOCTXT FROM SHPRQ SR INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = SR.SKUKEY INNER JOIN BZPTN VD ON VD.OWNRKY = SR.OWNRKY AND VD.PTNRKY = SR.DPTNKY AND VD.PTNRTY = 'CT' WHERE 1 = 1
AND SHPRQK = #SHPRQK#

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TH.TASKKY) AS CNT FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT IN ('PPC', 'FPC') AND TI.QTTAOR > 0 AND DECODE(#DOTYPE#, '1', TI.SHPOKY, '2', TI.DOORKY) = #DOORKY#

SELECT TH.DOCCAT AS DOCCAT , TH.TASOTY AS DOCUTY , TH.TASKKY AS DOCUKY , TH.TASKKY AS TASKKY , TI.TASKIT AS TASKIT , TI.SHPOKY AS SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT AS SHPOIT , NVL((SELECT AREAKY FROM LOCMA WHERE WAREKY = TH.WAREKY AND LOCAKY = TI.LOCASR),' ') AS AREAKY , TI.LOCASR , TI.SKUKEY , TI.DESC01 , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTTAOR , SUM(TI.QTTAOR) AS QTCOMP , TI.SUOMKY AS UOMKEY , TI.DOORKY AS DOORKY FROM TASDH TH INNER JOIN TASDI TI ON TI.TASKKY = TH.TASKKY WHERE 1 = 1 AND TH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND TH.TASOTY = '210' AND TI.STATIT IN ('PPC', 'FPC') AND TI.QTTAOR > 0 AND DECODE(#DOTYPE#, '1', TI.SHPOKY, '2', TI.DOORKY) = #DOORKY# GROUP BY TH.DOCCAT , TH.TASOTY , TH.TASKKY , TI.TASKIT , TI.SHPOKY , TI.SHPOIT , TI.LOCASR , TI.SKUKEY , TI.DESC01 , TI.SUOMKY , TI.DOORKY , TH.WAREKY

SELECT RH.DOCCAT AS DOCCAT , RH.RCPTTY AS DOCUTY , RH.RECVKY AS DOCUKY , RH.RECVKY AS RECVKY , RI.RECVIT AS RECVIT , RI.SEBELN AS SEBELN , RI.SEBELP AS SEBELP , RI.AREAKY AS AREAKY , NVL((SELECT SHORTX FROM AREMA WHERE WAREKY = RH.WAREKY AND AREAKY = RI.AREAKY),' ') AS AREANM , RI.LOCAKY , RI.SKUKEY , RI.DESC01 , SUM(RI.QTYRCV) AS QTYRCV , RI.UOMKEY AS UOMKEY , RI.LOTA07 AS DOORKY , SM.ASKU05 , SM.DESC01 , RI.LOTA10 , RI.LOTA11 , RI.LOTA12 , RI.LOTA13 , RI.LOTA14 , RI.LOTA15 , RI.LOTA16 , RI.LOTA17 , RH.ARCPTD AS ASNDAT , RH.DOCDAT FROM RECDH RH INNER JOIN RECDI RI ON RI.RECVKY = RH.RECVKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = RH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = RI.SKUKEY WHERE 1 = 1 AND RH.WAREKY = #WAREKY#
AND RI.SEBELN = (SELECT MAX(EBELN) FROM IFWMS103 WHERE USRID2 = (SELECT MAX(SVBELN) FROM TASDI WHERE DOORKY = #DOORKY#))
AND RI.LOTA07 = #DOORKY#
GROUP BY RH.DOCCAT , RH.RCPTTY , RH.RECVKY , RH.RECVKY , RI.RECVIT , RI.SEBELN , RI.SEBELP , RH.WAREKY , RI.LOCAKY , RI.SKUKEY , RI.DESC01 , RI.UOMKEY , RI.LOTA07 , SM.ASKU05 , SM.DESC01 , RI.AREAKY , SM.DESC01 , RI.LOTA10 , RI.LOTA11 , RI.LOTA12 , RI.LOTA13 , RI.LOTA14 , RI.LOTA15 , RI.LOTA16 , RI.LOTA17 , RH.ARCPTD , RH.DOCDAT
sqlMap.insert: MERGE INTO WKSIGN A USING DUAL ON (A.DOCCAT = #DOCCAT# AND A.DOCUTY = #DOCUTY# AND A.DOCUKY = #DOCUKY#) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.SIGNFL = #SIGNFL# , A.LMODAT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.LMOTIM = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , A.LMOUSR = #SES_USER_ID# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DOCCAT, DOCUTY, DOCUKY, SIGNFL, CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR, LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR, INDBZL, INDARC, UPDCHK ) VALUES ( #DOCCAT#, #DOCUTY#, #DOCUKY#, #SIGNFL#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID#, NVL(#INDBZL#, ' '), NVL(#INDARC#, ' '), NVL(#UPDCHK#, 0) )
